answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 65540 Country: India Title: Delaying namaz is right or wrong Question: Delaying namaz for collecting fund for masjid is right or wrong? Answer ID: 65540 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 862/869/L=08/1437) It is not right to delay the salah regularly in the name of collecting fund for the mosque as it causes problem to the namazis . However, if there is delay sometimes which does not trouble the namazis then it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
